steps.title: Block
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as engine_block.ipt.
Sketch the deck outline on the XY Plane: 546 x 239 with R13.7 (0.54 in) corners, the bore line 81 from the top edge. Extrude 180 down.
steps.note: The drawing is the deck (top face) plan only, in inches. The block depth (180) is not given; it is chosen to show the bores and water jacket.

steps.title: Cylinder bores
actions: Hole 3.684 in (93.6) diameter, Through, at 4.85 in (123.2) centres: Rectangular Pattern 4.

steps.title: Water jacket
actions: Sketch a ring 111.6 to 140.6 diameter round each bore on a Work Plane 15 below the deck. Extrude, Cut, 125 deep (the coolant space).
steps.note: The coolant surrounds each cylinder, so the heat from burning fuel goes into the water and out through the radiator.

steps.title: Head bolt bosses
actions: Sketch 18 diameter circles on the 16 head bolt centres (84 x 80 round each bore) on the Work Plane 15 below the deck. Extrude 125 down, Join.
steps.note: The head bolt holes are 58 from the bore centre, inside the water jacket. Solid bosses carry them through the coolant, so the bolts do not open into the water.

steps.title: Head bolt holes
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Rectangular Pattern
actions: Hole 0.43 in (11) diameter, 60 deep, four round each bore: 16 holes ("0.42/0.43 DIA CAST 16 HOLES").

steps.title: Push rod holes
actions: Hole 0.453 in (11.5) diameter, Through, with a 30 counterbore 10 deep, two to each cylinder: 8 holes ("0.448/0.458 DIA THRU 8 HOLES").

steps.title: Coolant holes
actions: Hole 10 diameter, 16 deep into the jacket, front and back of each bore.

steps.title: Dowel holes
actions: Hole 14 diameter, 20 deep, in the two top corners (the head locating dowels).
